requirement.normalizedRequirement: Survival resources shall support the assessed abandonment environments for at least maximum_expected_rescue_time_days and shall cover habitable environment, cold/wind/sun protection, accommodation space, sustenance, safe access/exit, and rescue communication.
requirement.requiredInputs: Operational assessment, survival-resource inventory, duration evidence, and six coverage indicators
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: Taking into account the presence of any hazards, as identified in the assessment in chapter 1, resources shall be provided to support survival following abandoning ship, whether to the water, to ice or to land, for the maximum expected time of rescue. These resources shall provide: a habitable environment; protection of persons from the effects of cold, wind and sun; space to accommodate persons equipped with thermal protection adequate for the environment; means to provide sustenance; safe access and exit points; and means to communicate with rescue assets.
